description: Plan FLOW commands with an agent

script: addValue(foam.core.reflow.ai.Propose.create({command: args.join(' ')}, this));

var code = args.join(' ');
    addValue(foam.core.reflow.Script.create({code: code, autoRun: !! code}, this), true);
